about.en: Paimon Polymarket SPV Token (pPOLY) is a pre-IPO exposure token issued by Paimon Finance, a platform that tokenizes interests in private credit and private-company equity through special purpose vehicles. It is a BEP-20 token on BNB Chain at 0x1D80392d12caaaf9e333bb0bb7f021eacf297Fe6, first distributed through a Binance Wallet pre-access sale in September 2026 at 15.50 USD per token. It gives indirect economic exposure to Polymarket-related assets held by the SPV; it is not an official Polymarket token and carries no direct claim on Polymarket equity.
